issue.title: Stabilize pending-question marker cleanup test under full-suite load
issue.description: During unrelated coder-alias verification on 2026-08-03, full just check failed tests/test_axe_run_agent_helpers_questions.py::test_pending_question_marker_deleted_on_kill, but the same node passed in the immediate focused rerun alongside other failing nodes. This looks like full-suite/xdist timing or state leakage around pending question marker cleanup, not a deterministic regression in the alias changes. Reproduce under suite load, identify the cleanup race or shared state dependency, and make the test deterministic without weakening the marker-deletion guarantee.

payload.close_reason: Backlog triage 2026-08-05: consolidating the full-parallel-suite / xdist flake class onto umbrella task sase-ct ('Flaky ACE TUI tests under full parallel just test run'). Every one of these reports the same shape — a single node fails under the full four-to-27-worker 'just test' or 'just check' run and passes immediately in isolation — so they share a root-cause class (xdist load sensitivity and shared-state leakage across workers) rather than per-test logic bugs. Per-test detail, including sase-cu's pump-free clipboard-task diagnosis, stays readable on each bead, and a +1 with fresh evidence reopens any of them if a specific node turns into a deterministic failure.
